## Mandatory continuity update

- [ ] Before merging, change or append a `[COMMITTED]` entry with actual tests/results and any remaining blockers. Do not claim a passing test before it completes.
- [ ] `node scripts/check-continuity.mjs --base origin/main` passes for this proposal.
- [ ] No accidental Vercel deployment trigger or credential exposure.
